## Summary
A clear and concise description of the proposed feature or operational enhancement.

## Target Epic / Module
- [ ] `EPIC-01`: Maintenance Data & Event Entry (Cleaning Logs / Citizen Defect Reports)
- [ ] `EPIC-02`: Searchable Facility & Ticket Dashboard
- [ ] `EPIC-03`: Summary Indicators & Operational KPIs
- [ ] `EPIC-04`: Status Drill-Down & Ticket Lifecycle
- [ ] `EPIC-05`: Alert & Exception Management (SLA Overdue)
- [ ] Infrastructure & DevOps Automation (Docker / Jenkins / Testing)

## Proposed Feature & Business Value
Describe why this feature is needed, which user persona benefits (Citizen, Cleaning Staff, Technician, Supervisor, or Administrator), and what value it adds to public sanitation management.

## Expected Behaviour
Describe how the feature will look, behave, and integrate into the existing Spring Boot / web application.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] User story and acceptance criteria formalized.
- [ ] REST API endpoints documented with request/response payloads.
- [ ] Unit tests (JUnit 5) and UI tests (Selenium) authored.
- [ ] Docker Compose runtime validated without host port collision.
- [ ] Definition of Done checklist fully satisfied.
